model_output.verdict: A mathematics teacher with clear classroom experience and a developing digital learning design portfolio.
write_up: Your resume points toward mathematics teaching, with digital learning design emerging as a second direction. A recruiter can see the classes you teach and the materials you create, so the teaching story is easy to follow. The design work is promising but needs a little more detail for someone reading it as a career move.

The Canvas functions module is your best model: it names the subject, the format and the platform. Your current teaching line also gives a recruiter a useful picture of your classes. One thing to check is the experience count in your headline against the teaching dates below it.

Start by updating that count, then add what you do with the professional learning community and what goes into the exam-review videos. Those details can show more of your work without taking space away from the classroom experience.
